title: White House Says a Canada Deal Is Close; Ottawa Says It Isn't
dek: Twenty months into the tariff war, Washington reshuffles its 50% list a week before the midterms while Canadian officials say a wide gap remains.
body: From 30 Oct, Canadian plywood and some paper come off the 50% list; cocoa powder, vinyl flooring and carpets go on.

panels.label: The White House Says
panels.text: Hassett says talks are "gathering steam" and "very close to finally having a deal."

panels.label: Ottawa Says
panels.text: Carney says any progress came "because the U.S. is coming closer to our position."

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Washington says a deal is near; Ottawa says the gap is wide. At stake is who sets the terms of North American trade.
